components.text: If you experience a total loss in an earthquake, can you afford to rebuild, replace your belongings, find another place to live, and pay off your existing loan? You can protect your home, belongings, and equity for less than a daily cup of coffee. That’s the support you won’t get from FEMA.

components.header: Natural Disasters are on the Rise
components.text: As of 2024, there is greater shaking possible in California than previously mapped by The National Seismic Hazard Model from the United States Geological Survey. Compared with the prior 2018 model, California locations have up to a 10% increase in the chances of experiencing a damaging earthquake. The new USGS data also marks the chances of a 7.0 magnitude earthquake being 80% greater statewide than noted in 2018.
